$comment: Every code the backend returns, by call. severity: what validate / the job reports. message: the plain-language template; {placeholders} are filled by the backend (first/last are inclusive frame numbers for display). The backend's technical text goes in the warning's `detail`. See CONTRACT.md section 6.

no_hand.message: No hand found in frame {frame}. Pick a frame where the palm is clearly visible and click it.

track_lost.message: CueFX lost the hand on {lost} of {total} frames. Pick the hand again on a frame in the middle of the hold, where the palm is clear.
track_lost.message_body_point: CueFX lost the {body_point} on {lost} of {total} frames. Pick the {body_point} again on a frame where it is clearly visible.

clip_unreadable.message: CueFX could not read this clip. Export it again as MP4 (H.264) or MOV, then retry.

clip_too_long.message: This clip has {frames} frames; CueFX takes up to {max_frames} ({max_seconds} s). Trim it to the part with the hand.

seed_far.message: Your click in frame {first} was not on a hand, so CueFX used the nearest one. Click the palm again if that is the wrong hand.

seed_far_from_body_point.message: Your click in frame {first} was not on the {body_point}, or the pose was not clear there. Click on the {body_point} again if the effect follows the wrong place.

side_from_click.message: Your click in frame {first} was on the {body_point}, not the {asked_side} one, so CueFX follows the {body_point}.

not_found.message: CueFX cannot find what this request asks for: {detail}

internal.message: CueFX hit an unexpected problem. Retry; if it happens again, send the server log to the CueFX team.

gpu_memory.message: The GPU ran out of memory while rendering. Lower the effect size or close other GPU apps, then retry.

server_lost.message: CueFX lost contact with the render server. Check that ComfyUI is running, then retry.

render_failed.message: The render failed during "{stage_name}". Retry; if it fails again, send the log to the CueFX team.

invalid_field.message: The cue has a value CueFX cannot read at {path}.

unknown_field.message: {path} is not a cue field. It is kept in the file but nothing uses it.

setting_not_used.message: {label} is saved with the cue, but the render does not use it yet.

no_track.message: No hand track yet, so there is nothing for the effect to follow. Pick the hand to analyse the clip.

track_invalid.message: The hand track in this cue is damaged ({path}). Analyse the clip again.

release_in_lost_gap.message: The throw happens while the tracker has lost the hand ({first}–{last}), so the effect leaves from the last frame the hand was seen. Add a correction in that gap if it starts in the wrong place.

check_pass_edge.message: Check the hand passing in front at {first}–{last}: the mask edge is softest just before it lets go.

entrance_shortened.message: Entrance shortened to {seconds} s: the effect appears too close to the start of the clip.

placeholder_timings.message: No steady palm found; starting timings are placeholders. Set the appear and release frames yourself.

started_as_hold.message: No throw found in this clip, so the effect starts as Hold. Switch to Hold + throw to draw a flight path.

hold_shortened.message: The hold was shortened to the 8-second limit.

body_point_invalid.message: Choose what the effect follows: palm, fist, foot, knee, shoulder or head, and left or right for all but the head.

shape_invalid.message: Choose the effect's shape: sphere, ring, crystal or cube.

ending_invalid.message: Choose how the effect ends: Fade, Burst or Shatter.

vanish_extended.message: A {ending} needs at least {seconds} s, so the vanish was made longer: it now covers {first}–{last} more.

orbit_invalid.message: Check the orbit: the radius must be above 0 (up to 10 sizes), the speed within 3600 degrees per second and the tilt between 0 and 90 degrees.

hold_path_unused.message: This effect is set to Hold, so the flight path is not used.
hold_path_unused.message_orbit: This effect is set to Orbit, so the flight path is not used.

behaviour_invalid.message: Choose how the effect behaves: Hold, Hold + throw, Charge up or Orbit.

no_path.message: No flight path yet: the effect will stop where it is thrown and vanish there. Draw a path from the palm.

orb_holds_after_route.message: The effect reaches the end of its path and stays still for {first}–{last} before it is gone. Move the vanish earlier or add a path point.

window_grown.message: The effect window was grown to {first}–{last} so it covers the entrance.

window_cut_short.message: The clip is too short to cover the whole entrance: frames {first}–{last} get no effect.

window_trimmed.message: The effect can run up to 8 seconds (193 frames). Move the vanish earlier or remove late path points.

version_unsupported.message: This cue file is a version CueFX cannot read. CueFX reads cue versions 2.1, 2.2 and 2.3.

hand_invalid.message: Choose which of the person's hands holds the effect: left or right.

frame_outside_clip.message: {path} points at a frame outside the clip.

correction_duplicate.message: There are two corrections on frame {first}. Keep one.

effect_range_length.message: The effect window must be 8k+1 frames long (9, 17, … 121).

effect_range_outside.message: The effect window runs outside the clip.

canvas_invalid.message: The effect canvas setting {path} is not valid.

release_not_after_appear.message: The throw (frame {first}) must come after the effect appears.

route_empty.message: The flight path has no points. It needs at least the point where it leaves the palm.

route_start.message: The flight path must start on the throw frame.

route_order.message: Flight path points must be in time order: check frame {first}.

route_position_missing.message: Every flight path point after the first needs a position ({path}).

easing_invalid.message: {path} must be Linear, Ease in, Ease out or Ease in-out.

occluder_invalid.message: {path}: choose who passes in front (left hand or right hand).

tint_invalid.message: The tint must be a colour like #ffb35c.
